🍎 LCM · SAME TIME AGAIN

When will both trees be ready together?

Apple trees are ready every 4 days and pear trees every 6 days. If both are ready today, in how many days will both be ready together again?

Find LCM of 4 and 6

Think: list multiples until the first one appears in both lists.

Need a hint?

HCFUse factors. Pick the greatest one shared by all the numbers.
LCMUse multiples. Pick the smallest positive number shared by all the lists.

HCF is also called the greatest common factor (GCF). LCM means least common multiple.
